failed_or_abandoned: Untuned optical model (PTFE 0.97, array reflectance 0.5, detection 0.25, no grids) gave a collection efficiency of 0.28, 2.5x LZ's g1; retuned to 0.11 (propagation mean 36 -> 27 ns).

First scan of the ER-NR timing difference varied the NR triplet lifetime at fixed I_s/I_t = 1, which changed the pulse shape independently of the mean and produced d ~ 1.2-1.7 even at 0.5 ns; replaced by a singlet-fraction scan at fixed lifetimes.
Reproducing LZ's dedicated PSD paper (arXiv:2603.26877) was not attempted: not read.
